visualCharacteristics: rc12: Light grey (#f6f7fb) band; 2x2 grid of large orange/magenta animated stat numbers (21X, 7K+, 60K, 165K) each with a caption, separated by thin rules. No-image cards in 2x2 grid with oversized colored stat value and caption, divider rules.

contentPattern.authoring: One row per stat: either one cell with value paragraph then caption paragraph, or two cells (value | caption). Values are plain text, not headings.

usage: 2x2 grid of oversized stat values with captions and divider rules.
reuseGuidance: Use for key-figure rows. Not for linked cards.
